metaDesc: The 6 closest hotels to Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Samitivej Sukhumvit, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 6 closest stays to Samitivej Sukhumvit, with real distances and prices.
intro: This page lists hotels that are genuinely close to Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital — for anyone staying with a patient, coming in for a check-up, or here for a few days of treatment and wanting a bed within walking range. The key thing is that the hospital sits in the middle of Soi 49, not on the main road, so we focus on places inside Soi 49 and Soi 49/11 that you can walk to in 3–8 minutes. The Phrom Phong options are included for people who also want the BTS. Prices below run cheapest to priciest and are approximate starting rates per night.

blocks.html: Short answer: Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital sits deep inside Soi Sukhumvit 49 (No. 133), about 880 m from BTS Phrom Phong — a bit far to walk from the station. The hotels you can genuinely walk to are the ones on Soi 49 and Soi 49/11 themselves, such as Quartier by Montraj, Walton Suites and Adelphi Forty-Nine (a 3–8 minute walk). If you want both the hospital and the BTS close, pick the Soi 39 / Phrom Phong side and take a motorbike taxi or cab into the soi for the last 5 minutes.

blocks.text: Hotels near Samitivej Sukhumvit, by distance & budget

items.name: The LA49 Hotel
items.meta: 📍 4-min walk (280 m) to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 3-star · Best for: Tighter budgets · rooftop pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel right on Soi 49 with the lowest starting rate in this pocket. Rooms are simple but clean, and there is a rooftop pool and gym. Reviews stay consistently strong, and it is under a 5-minute walk to the hospital — handy for a multi-night stay with a patient when you are watching the budget.

items.name: Quartier by Montraj Sukhumvit
items.meta: 📍 3-min walk (220 m) to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 4-star · Best for: Best value · closest to the hospital · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Soi Sukhumvit 49/11, only about 220 m from the hospital — the shortest walk on this list. Rooms have a French-inspired look, compact but well laid out, with a rooftop pool and gym. Reviewers single out the value versus other hotels in the same area. A solid pick for patient families who want to nip back to rest and return to the hospital easily.

items.name: Metropolis Suites Bangkok, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.4 km) · 16-min walk to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 4-star · Best for: Hilton brand · near BTS Phrom Phong · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Soi Sukhumvit 39 on the Phrom Phong side, part of Hilton's Tapestry Collection. The residence-style rooms come with a kitchenette, washing machine and a Japanese washlet. It is walkable to BTS Phrom Phong and EmQuartier, and the hospital is a quick motorbike-taxi or cab ride into Soi 49. Good if you want a branded hotel plus easy BTS access.

items.name: Adelphi Forty-Nine
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (450 m) to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · free shuttle to Samitivej · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment at 16 Soi Sukhumvit 49 with roomy units and full kitchens — good for families or longer stays where you want to cook. There is a skyline pool and a gym. The real plus is a complimentary shuttle to Samitivej Hospital and BTS Thong Lor, which makes a big difference if you are bringing an elderly relative or a child in for treatment.

items.name: Walton Suites Sukhumvit
items.meta: 📍 3-min walk (220 m) to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · large suites with kitchen · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Serviced suites on Soi Sukhumvit 49/11, just about 220 m from the hospital. Units are one- and two-bedroom, 50–110 sqm, with a full kitchen and a separate living area — ideal for families travelling together or week-long stays. There is a rooftop pool and gym, and it is an easy walk back to rest between hospital visits.

items.name: Marriott Executive Apartments, Bangkok Townhall Sukhumvit
items.meta: 📍 3-min walk (240 m) to Samitivej Sukhumvit · ★ 5-star · Best for: Premium long stays · full kitchen + services · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An upscale serviced apartment on Soi Sukhumvit 49, about 240 m from the hospital. Units have full kitchens and generous living space with 5-star hotel service, a pool, gym and work areas. It suits longer treatment stays or a whole family who want full comfort. It is the priciest on this list, but you get the space and service to match.

faq.q: Can I walk from BTS Phrom Phong to Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital?
faq.a: You can, but it is a fair distance. The hospital is deep inside Soi 49, about 880 m from BTS Phrom Phong — roughly a 12–15 minute walk. With luggage or a patient, it is easier to grab a motorbike taxi or cab from the mouth of Soi 39/49 for the last 5 minutes; a motorbike taxi runs about 30–40 baht.

faq.q: Are there family rooms or units with a kitchen near the hospital?
faq.a: Yes, plenty — Soi Sukhumvit 49 is a serviced-apartment zone. Walton Suites, Adelphi Forty-Nine and Marriott Executive Apartments all offer one- and two-bedroom units with full kitchens, good for families staying with a patient or settling in for a week and cooking for themselves. Metropolis Suites has in-room kitchenettes and washing machines too.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital?
faq.a: The simplest way is a taxi straight from Suvarnabhumi into Soi 49, about 40–50 minutes depending on traffic, roughly 350–450 baht including tolls. Alternatively, take the Airport Rail Link to Phaya Thai, switch to the BTS to Phrom Phong, then a short motorbike-taxi or cab into the soi. With a patient, the direct taxi is the easier choice.
